simple.meaning: תַּכְלִית (taklîyth) is a Hebrew object word meaning “completion ; by implication, an extremity.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Nehemiah 3:21. The surrounding context includes family line.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תַּכְלִית (H8503) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.full: H8503. taklith תַּכְלִית noun feminine end, completeness ; — ׳ת absolute Job 11:7 ; 28:3 ; construct Neh 3:21 2 t.; — 1 end , וגו ׳בֵּית ׳וְעַדתֿ Neh 3:21 even unto the end of the house of Eliashib; ׳עַדתֿ עִםהֿשֶׁךְ אוֺר Job 26:10 unto the end of (= boundary between) light and darkness ; ׳וּלְכָלתֿ חוֺקֵר הוּא 28:3 and to every end (= to the farthest limit) he exploreth ; ׳עַדתֿ תִּמְצָא שַׁדַּי 11:7 unto the end of Shadday wilt thou reach (so as to know him fully) ? 2 completeness , as accusative of manner (Da Synt. § 70 b ) ׳ת שְׂנֵאתִים שִׂנְאָה Psa 139:22 with completeness of hatred I hate them .
